profile.headline: Software Engineer at Snap | Ex-Twitch | Ex-Microsoft
profile.summary:
My areas of interest are: Large Distributed Systems, Backend Software Engineering, Highly Agentic Coding Frameworks (e.g. Claude Code, Codex), Scalability, Resilience, Performance Optimization, Object Oriented Software Design, Algorithms, Infrastructure, Frameworks, Tooling.

● Languages: Python, Java, Bash/Shell scripting, SQL, C#
● Technologies: Claude Code CLI, Codex CLI, Cursor, GCP, AWS, Azure, Git, Terraform, Airflow, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Spanner, Docker, Redis, Jupyter, Power BI, Looker, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL 

Experienced with software engineering best practices, including agile development, continuous integration, unit/e2e testing, code reviews, design documentation, code documentation, code versioning, code readability/maintainability, automation

Venezuelan / Hispanic / Latinx / Latino
